def parse_inr(text):
    """Parse a formatted rupee amount like "₹1,23,456.78" into integer paise. Rejects text without ₹."""
    original = text
    text = text.strip()
    
    if "₹" not in text:
        raise InvoiceError("BAD_AMOUNT", original)
    
    neg = text.startswith("-")
    if neg:
        text = text[1:].strip()
    
    if not text.startswith("₹"):
        raise InvoiceError("BAD_AMOUNT", original)
    text = text[1:].strip()
    
    if "." not in text:
        raise InvoiceError("BAD_AMOUNT", original)
    
    body, paise_str = text.rsplit(".", 1)
    
    if len(paise_str) != 2 or not paise_str.isdigit():
        raise InvoiceError("BAD_AMOUNT", original)
    
    body = body.replace(",", "")
    if not body or not body.isdigit():
        raise InvoiceError("BAD_AMOUNT", original)
    
    rupees = int(body)
    paise = int(paise_str)
    total = rupees * 100 + paise
    
    return -total if neg else total
